1 of those cases were at different stages in different audits; the most advanced stage is shown.

definitions.flaggedForReview: Open checks in the covered records that have not passed the evidence review; the amount is what the check flagged, not money a supplier owes.
definitions.supportedPotential: For open cases whose evidence review passed, the supported amount minus any returns you recorded; the most a request could ask for, not a forecast.
definitions.approvedOutstanding: For supplier requests you approved that are still open, the approved amount not yet covered by a return you recorded.
definitions.promised: The latest amount a supplier said it would return on an open request, capped at what is still outstanding; a statement, not money received.
definitions.customerRecordedReturns: Refunds and applied credits you recorded with a reference; they have not been matched to a bank or accounting record.
definitions.matchedReturns: Returns independently matched to a bank or accounting record; not available yet, so shown as unavailable rather than zero.
definitions.partialReturns: Open supplier requests where you recorded part of the money coming back.
definitions.closedWithoutRecovery: Requests closed with no return recorded.
definitions.needingCustomerAction: Cases where the next step is yours, including checks you have not reviewed yet.
